entries.title: Trust & Growth
entries.summary: RUS added automatic football data auditing, richer search-engine metadata, structured data, a generated sitemap and the new What's New page.
items: Automatic GitHub data audit with readable error and warning reports
Structured Organization, team, game, player and collection metadata
Canonical URLs and improved social/search metadata
What's New history with a new-update indicator

entries.title: RUS Credibility Package
entries.summary: Major data pages gained freshness information, methodology links and an easier way to report corrections.
items: Visible data-updated stamps on major data pages

entries.title: Desktop V2
entries.summary: The desktop site was redesigned to use the extra screen space like a sports data product instead of a stretched mobile page.
items: Sticky team and Game Center sidebars

entries.title: Football App Experience
entries.summary: The football experience became personalized around favorite teams, games and RUS model information.
items: Game Center with ELO win probability and matchup context

entries.title: Mobile App Shell & PWA
entries.summary: Rural Utah Sports gained an app-style mobile shell and installable Home Screen experience.
